service.name: SAVER Verifier
service.description: Fact-check claims before they are used in AI-generated research, reports or decisions. Checks figures, dates and source attributions against web evidence; returns a verdict, explanation and cited sources. 0.20 USDC per completed verification via x402 v2 on Base. Confidence is model-assessed; wallet security and arithmetic require dedicated tools.
